title: investment-assist stance payload
description: Stance and entry plan for one subject (country or commodity) and one asset class, for an IDR-based investor. Extends worldbankscape's score.schema.json (vendored in schema/worldbankscape/): same score, confidence, flags, stale_inputs and disclaimer semantics, its date/semver/flag definitions by $ref; `sources` plays the part of its `attribution`. Heuristic context, not investment advice.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract (1.0.0 frozen by slice S1-contracts; 1.1.0 adds the optional portfolio.rebalance_pt and portfolio.tilt_pt, S42).

subject.description: ISO3 code (country) or worldbankscape commodity code.

model_fingerprint.description: Hash of rules + weights + config; a change segments the journal and the paper record.

score.description: 50 = neutral. Layer-1 score after regime shift and layer-2 overrides.

confidence.description: Lowered for every stale or missing input.

style.description: How the delta is carried out; its direction is the sign of portfolio.delta. ladder: when the regime is risk_off or a gated rule says so (adds), or, since S39, for any mandate leg more than TRANSITION_PT (10) from its target, adds and trims alike (a ladder with a negative delta is a laddered trim). lump: one add. none: a smaller trim, a hold, or no holdings.

current_pct.description: null when holdings are unavailable (financer listed in stale_inputs).

target_pct.description: Benchmark + tilt, scaled pro rata with the other mandate legs to a sum of at most 100 (PLAN S39); 0 outside the mandate.

benchmark_pct.description: The whole-portfolio benchmark weight of this (subject, asset); 0 outside the 80/20 mandate (PLAN S39). Absent in payloads before model 0.4.0.

rebalance_pt.description: Schema 1.1 (PLAN S42): the part of the gap (target_pct - current_pct) that moves to the benchmark, not a model call: the gap less tilt_pt, i.e. the benchmark share after the pro-rata cap minus current_pct, to within 0.1 pt. Outside the mandate (benchmark 0) it is -current_pct. null when holdings are unavailable. Absent in payloads before 1.1.0.

tilt_pt.description: Schema 1.1 (PLAN S42): the model's own part of the gap: the stance tilt (target - benchmark before the cap) times the cap's scale, rounded to 0.1 pt; rebalance_pt + tilt_pt = target_pct - current_pct exactly. 0 outside the mandate and for a neutral leg. null when holdings are unavailable. Absent before 1.1.0.

notes.description: How layer 5 valued the holdings, e.g. lines valued at their last trade price (PLAN S32). Absent when there is nothing to say.

sources.description: Attribution of every source that fed this stance.
